description: Checks a site's robots.txt, sitemaps and llms.txt: robots.txt with the verdict for each AI crawler (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and more), Content-Signal lines, the sitemaps, llms.txt, the agent files under /.well-known (AI catalog, MCP server cards, A2A agent card) and whether the home page has a Markdown version. Use it to see whether AI crawlers may read the site, whether its sitemap and llms.txt are in place, and what it offers agents. Only the origin of the URL is used. result has robotsTxt (url, status, contentSignals), aiCrawlers (token, operator, role, allowed), sitemaps (URL count, a sample, files), agentFiles (each with outcome ok, not_found, blocked or failed), markdownVersion and findings. A status of null means the site gave no answer. Cached for 1 hour. These are deterministic checks of public pages fetched by Agent Ready Website Audit, with no AI model and no account. They do not cover rankings, keyword volumes, backlinks or how AI answers mention the brand. Returns JSON: summary (one sentence), result (the details below), resultId and reportUrl (null). The check saves nothing. When the person asks for a link to open or share later, pass resultId to share_report within an hour. Errors come back as one plain sentence. Recorded: the checked domain and path (never the query string), the tool, which checks failed and the app name; never an IP address or page text.

url.description: Any page on the site: an absolute http or https URL, such as https://example.com/pricing.

name: check_robots_sitemap_llms_txt
title: Check robots.txt, sitemaps and llms.txt
